lastReleaseMessage: The second fail anchor is wired: a mission can pre-place a Lantern, and a building the mission names as an anchor ends the mission when it falls

items: Declared milestone moved M1 to M6 on 2026-08-26. M6 Art Integration is the track receiving the work and has been for weeks; M1 Vertical Slice stays open behind it. The old declaration paired M1 with a rule that the number only advances on a gameplay deliverable, which froze the number against a track nobody was on. The number now counts Roadmap deliverables across all nine milestones, so art work moves it.

How the 45 is derived, countable off the GDD Roadmap tab: 22 of 49 deliverables shipped. M0 8/8, M1 3/6, M2 2/4, M3 0/4, M4 6/8, M5 0/4, M6 3/5, M7 0/5, M8 0/5. Recounted 2026-09-04 off the live Roadmap tab. The previous 18 of 47, anchored 2026-08-26, described the Keepers milestone as two of six; it now reads six of eight, so the old figure was stale rather than wrong when written. The same counting rule applies, one struck Roadmap deliverable is one shipped item.

M1 Vertical Slice, three of six shipped and one previously mis-recorded. Open: Shambler + Lunger combat tuning, and Hatchery destruction + Coral Receding VFX (hatchery.gd is a scaffold with group membership, HP 800, a 2x2 footprint and four spawn constants; no spawn loop and no destruction handler exist). Mis-recorded: the Roadmap strikes 'Hold the Wall mission script (5-7 wave cadence)' as shipped, but source/data/missions/m1_default.tres is 'Mission 1: Hold the Line' at target_day 30, which against game_clock.DAY_LENGTH_SEC of 60 is a 30-minute mission with four horde nights at days 7, 14, 21 and 28. Neither a 5-7 wave slice nor the 5-7 minute mission M1's own target paragraph describes.

M6 Art Integration, three of five shipped. Building sprites, terrain tile set and HUD icon set are in. Open: unit sheets, where three of six scenes carry Spine rigs (scout, rifleman, marksman) and harpoonist, tommy and trench_sweeper carry none; and enemy sheets, where only the Shambler is rigged and the other seven are static single frames.

M4 Keepers, six of eight shipped and the milestone still in progress. The registry autoload, the housing-capacity draft trigger, the 80-card pool, the draft modal, the gold reroll and the exclusive and standalone card families are struck. Open: the keeper card art, so the modal ships on placeholder presentation, and the category filter on the skirmish setup screen.

Live defect inside the active track: tools/bake_spine_sheets.gd configures two bakes, shambler and scout, while rifleman.tscn and marksman.tscn both carry rigs. Past the eight-unit LIVE_RIG_BUDGET in source/units/unit_lod.gd a demoted rig has no baked sheet to fall back to. Queued as bar-raise-2026-08-24-rising-asset-pipeline-01, which names the Rifleman only.

tools/bench_scale.gd run at v0.67.0, all seventeen cases, logged as the 2026-09-22 entry in docs/OPTIMIZATION_LOG.md: the target case fits at 16.12 ms against 16.67, forty static units cost 25.94 ms against 9.88 for forty rigged, and a thousand enemies have gone from 11.3 to 16.26; shipped v0.68.0
1,096 inherited version stamps tagged across 104 files, measured against this project's own 317 released versions, comments only, idempotent; shipped v0.68.0
check_spine_versions.py reads the skeleton format each shipped Windows library accepts and asserts it against the lock; proved to catch a mismatch on a scratch copy; shipped v0.68.0
the renderer buffer follows the pool through enemy_renderer.grow_to(), held by a test in both directions; D-OPEN-43's default executed; shipped v0.68.0
buildings fill the fog vision array before units and the overflow warns once with the demand, the cap and the fix; shipped v0.68.0
a failed publish-gdd rides out with the release post, and check_gdd_integrity.py runs in the preship gauntlet on every commit rather than only inside a release; shipped v0.68.0

both rig types baked, imported and committed at 3072x1536 with seats inside the baker's valid range; the sheet check reads the row role order through an alias table and fails on an unknown name, proved by swapping two rows; the unbaked list is empty; v0.61.13 b331ef2

the baker's two outputs go through verified writers: temporary path, read back, compare dimensions or bytes, then rename; a failed readback removes the temporary and fails the bake; re-baked through the new path and the gate passes; v0.61.13

docs/ART_INTEGRATION_NOTES.md gained a rig delivery checklist: the six rows by role, the facing rule, the detached-art rule with the measured frame counts, the alpha rule, the no-fallback rule and the three commands; v0.61.13

save_load filters restored keeper, offer and research identifiers against each holder's own registry and warns naming what it dropped; a holder with no registry is trusted rather than emptied; v0.61.14
the save format version moves again, so the guard reading it has something to catch; v0.61.14

the version had sat at 1 through every field the payload gained; bumped to 2 with a version history and a recorded key set per version, and a test drives the real snapshot and fails on any added or removed key so the bump cannot be forgotten; v0.61.14

a test stages a stale truncated temporary file, calls the real options save, and asserts it returns true, leaves no temporary and leaves a file that reloads; writing it is what exposed the save that had never worked; v0.61.14

source/vfx/render_warn.gd, a preloaded library rather than an autoload so it adds no root path and no boot-order dependency, wired into the eight silent null-texture branches, once per distinct cause per run; v0.61.14
the load-failure signal carried a real cause and nothing listened; the screen flow now connects for the duration of the call, folds the reason into the toast and pushes a warning; v0.61.14

scripts/check_spine_versions.py asserts the runtime descriptor is present and tracked and that every library it names is present and tracked, with non-Windows entries declared absent by design; wired into the gauntlet; v0.61.14

the same gate reads the version stamped in every delivered skeleton header and the descriptor's minimum and compares both to the lock; it found seven of eight skeletons at 4.3.23 against a lock recording 4.3.17, the lock is corrected and the one remaining rig is named on every run; v0.61.14

the playtest caveat is in README.md under Status: no mission places a Hatchery, Brood Mound or Leviathan Cyst, so there is nothing to clear and pressure arrives only on the wave director's clock, which makes a run read as pure defence. The build half needs placement rules and a Coral Receding specification that do not exist, and is carried as rising-keeper-structures-reach-a-spawn-site-2026-09-02;

the per-Node fallback now has a test that keeps it honest: it pins that all eight flags exist and default on, that the wave director still reads every one, that each per-Node scene resolves and carries the fields the branch depends on, and that the dispatcher keeps a per-Node exit. Both pools also warn once when they grow past their pre-allocated records, because the renderers hold fixed buffers.

the cross-project digest reads its roster from the canonical status files instead of hardcoding four projects, which is the defect behind five consecutive runs of this finding; its description, its scope prose and its comparison table follow; both copies, 2026-09-02

both pools warn once when they grow past their pre-allocated records, naming that the renderer buffer does not grow with them so the overflow is live and undrawn; commit b2f78e3. The sizing half, clamping per-type growth against renderer capacity, is a design choice about what happens at the ceiling and is carried as rising-pool-renderer-capacity-clamp-2026-09-02

map_preview.tscn grounds on Plains512, the texture iso_grid.gd draws, at native scale with no scale constant left in the file, and the fifteen positions are a real diamond tiling rather than the untuned scatter they were; recorded in ART_INTEGRATION_NOTES.md including that the spacing is computed rather than judged by eye; commit 0b8ff83

the scale benchmark counts frames past twice each case's own median, prints the worst one, and prints the process, physics and draw reading from that exact frame, which is what makes a spike attributable to script, physics or render; helper behaviour proved against known data; commit 1f380b3
scripts/check_best_practices.py:126-153 mirror_mismatches hard-fails and tests/run_tests.gd:2537-2553 asserts FRAMES_PER_ROW in constants.gd, unit.gd and enemy_base.gd; all three read 15.
